framework.note: Mandatory disclosure when 25%+ voting rights are acquired or intention to acquire is announced; forms the gating compliance for all takeover activity.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 4
framework.note: Prescribes exemptions (e.g. creeping acquisition up to 5% per year, transmission by succession, acquisition from promoter); relevant if any exemption is claimed.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 15
framework.note: Exemption from open offer if acquirer commits to divest excess shareholding within 12 months; common structure in consortial bids.

headline: TVS Electronics: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Sundaram Investment and Properties Consultants LLP, Gopal Srinivasan and Srilalitha Gopal filed disclosures under SEBI Takeover Regulations 31(4)–31(5), signalling a material shareholding acquisition or acquisition intent in TVS Electronics Limited.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE on 8 May 2026 under Regulations 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. These clauses require mandatory disclosure when a person or group acquires or announces intention to acquire shares carrying 25% or more voting rights. The filing names Sundaram Investment and Properties Consultants LLP as the acquirer entity, with Gopal Srinivasan and Srilalitha Gopal as key parties. The specific shareholding quantum, source of funds, and timeline for completion are contained in the full disclosure document filed with the exchange.
